bio: You'll feel right at home here and that is down to the pleasant atmosphere, friendly service and excellent, fresh cuisine cooked up by Werner Tobler. The set menu, La Table chez Bacchus, comprises four to six courses; the small à la carte selection includes dishes such as roasted pike-perch with pine nuts, ratatouille and white tomato butter. At lunchtime, there is also the option of a two- to four-course set menu. The setting is tasteful and upscale, with decorative touches in the form of bookshelves and a large mural; floor-to-ceiling windows allow plenty of light to flood in. Tip: You can buy cheese, spices, cakes, wines and more in the shop....
